title: The map replacements: res/field/matrices/replacements.json
description: The one file of ARCID_MAP_REPLACE (a/0/1/0): the entries (MapReplaceEntry in include/field/field_map.h) that MapMatrix_Patch applies, in order, to a map matrix as the field loads it (map_matrix.c, map_replace.c). Each picks a value by its condition, and when that isn't the first, replaces the first. tools/data/map_replace_data.py packs them.

matrix.description: The map matrix the entry applies to (its id)

kind.description: What the values are and what is replaced: map_model (0) swaps every cell of the matrix whose map model is the first value for the picked one, matrix (1) loads the picked matrix instead (MapReplace_Patch)

condition.description: What picks the value (MapReplaceVariables): the season, the version (black in Black and Black 2), the version and in White 2 the season, or, from 3 on, the condition of an event of EVENT_MAP_REPLACE_TABLE in map_replace.c, which is set when its work has the table's value

values.description: The value for each case of the condition, in this order: spring, summer, autumn and winter for season; black and white for version; black, white_spring, white_summer, white_autumn and white_winter for version_season; unset and set for an event. The first is the original, which a map_model entry looks for in the matrix. MAP_MODEL_* constants for map_model, MAP_MATRIX_* for matrix

unused.description: The entry's remaining value slots, of six, which the condition doesn't pick and the code doesn't read
